layer.capability: Bind the actual first Picard reference and scale data to a local recursive sparse mixed-scale coefficient solver with the pinned angular natural resolvent, axial remainder, full normalized eta derivatives, and unbounded channel support.
identity_binding: AxisData and wide source epsilon must equal x1.epsilon
wide source amplitude Lambda must equal x1.Lambda
fixed AxisData fields are rebuilt from x1.reference

coverage: eta-binomial hand polynomial and a4 channel

layer.remaining_boundary: The formal recursion does not prove global weighted AxisSpace membership, contraction convergence, a fixed point, paper-exact profile data, final velocity, forcing, or a real-arithmetic theorem. The focused checks do not cover m=1 or higher rows.

forbidden_inferences: formal all-order coefficient maps imply a convergent weighted-space fixed point
rowwise Picard stabilization proves a global norm bound or convergence rate
a finite smoke check or polynomial provider proves the actual theorem profile
sparse channel support is evidence that omitted channels are zero
formal-structure status can be promoted to paper-exact velocity
